summary: Full backend + frontend retest for Pragati Path v2 (cart/items/children/attendance). 26/26 pytest backend tests pass. All requested frontend flows verified: register with class dropdown (1-10), parent dashboard 'My Children' list, /children CRUD via add-child-btn modal, Shop tab with grouped items + addto buttons + cart bar + Checkout modal with order summary/UPI QR/child selector, /receipt/[id] printable view, admin dashboard tiles (tile-items, tile-attendance) + Children/Enrolled stat cards, /(admin)/items CRUD, /(admin)/attendance with P/A/L and class filter.

issues: Console still emits RN deprecation warnings (shadow* → boxShadow, props.pointerEvents, Image resizeMode). Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: Server correctly excludes _id everywhere (projection {'_id':0}) and excludes password_hash + issued_password from /admin/users.
Payment model: validates child belongs to parent, computes total/line_total from catalog (server-side), flags has_course; rejects empty items (400); admin cannot create payments (400).

Approval flow: course+child_id → child enrolled; if parent not previously enrolled, issues new 8-char password, stores bcrypt hash, sets issued_password, sends templated 'Welcome' notification with {user_id}/{password} substituted. Subsequent course approvals only generate 'Child Enrolled' info notification. Non-course payments get 'Payment Approved' notif — all verified.
Attendance upsert on (child_id, date) — unique index enforced; same date twice updates (not duplicates). /attendance/me returns 403 for non-owner child.
Children: auto-created on register from legacy fields; child_id_code format 'PPC-XXXXXX' verified; admin blocked from POST /children (400).
Stats returns total_children and enrolled_children keys (not the old 'enrolled_users').
Items: item_type Literal validated (Pydantic 422 for unknown types); parent gets 403 on /admin/items CRUD.
JWT auth with bcrypt $2b$ hashes, 30-day expiry, Authorization Bearer header (mobile-adapted, no cookies — correct for React Native).
All interactive elements have testID for Playwright. ClassPicker exposes class-option-1..10.
seed_data_creation: Test parents prefixed test_parent_/test_reject_/test_nocourse_/test_other_/ui_parent_ created via API and UI. Backend startup auto-seeds admin, 6 default items (Foundation/Excellence/Olympiad courses, Study Material Pack, Sample Paper Set, T-Shirt), default UPI & template.
